reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service from Santosh Kamble!
reviews.body:
I had an issue with unexpected roaming charges while using my Lebara SIM in Hong Kong. Santosh Kamble was extremely helpful, patient and professional. He carefully checked my account, explained the charges clearly, and even offered £3.28 in goodwill credit without me asking.

It's rare to receive such thoughtful customer service. I'm very grateful for his kindness and support. Thank you so much, Santosh! You truly deserve recognition for your excellent service!
Excellent Customer Service from Santosh Kamble!
